name: Borgarmalet
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Borgarmalet (Swedish-Saami trade pidgin) attested only in a few 18th-c. sentences (Hogstrom 1747); no phonological description exists.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1 languoid borg1236 (Borgarmalet), family Pidgin, AES extinct.

sources.note: Nothing on phonology; used only to harvest the bibliography (Kusmenko 2015, 2017; Bakker 2024; Högström 1747/1980 p. 77).

sources.citation: Кузьменко, Ю. К. 2015. Лексическая передача саамских способов действия в саамско-шведском пиджине XVIII века. Вестник СПбГУ, сер. 9, вып. 3: 98–108.
sources.note: Nothing. Full text read (pp. 98–108): analysis of the four 'give' verbs (stick, sätt, kast, släpp) as lexical rendering of Sámi aspectual/causative suffixes; characterises Borgarmålet as a pidgin with Swedish lexicon, no noun gender/number/case, no verb conjugation/tense; no phonology, no stress. Quotes Högström 1747 p. 77 and cites Kusmenko 2009 (Scandinavica X) for the pidgin-status argument.

sources.citation: Högström, Pehr. 1747. Beskrifning öfwer de til Sweriges Krona lydande Lapmarker. Stockholm. Chapter 3 ('Om Lapparnas Tungomål') §13, p. 77. Project Runeberg proofread text + facsimile; archive.org mirror of the Runeberg edition.
sources.note: Nothing. The sole primary attestation: one paragraph saying that townspeople and Sámi in the southern Lappmarks use a language 'that conforms to the nature of neither Swedish nor Lappish', followed by five example sentences with Swedish glosses. No remark on pronunciation, accent, or stress (nor any orthographic marking of it).

sources.citation: Bakker, Peter. 2024. Pidgins and Creoles With Germanic Lexifier Languages. Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Linguistics.
